pages.text: $(bold)Mana Shield$() (default trait of all four $(bold)Wizard Set$() pieces, $(bold)unleveled$())$(br2)Active as long as you wear $(bold)any single piece$() carrying this trait.$(br2)$(bold)Three effects$():$(li)$(bold)-10% magic damage per piece$() ($(bold)chained$(): about -19% with two pieces, -34.4% with four)$(li)$(bold)+2 max health per piece$() (stacks, +8 for the full set)

$(bold)Halved durations$(): all buffs and debuffs on you last half as long.$(br2)It $(bold)does not stack$() - always $(bold)x0.5$() no matter how many pieces; $(bold)infinite$() effects are unaffected.$(br2)$(italic)None of these apply while the armor is broken (durability exhausted); they return once repaired.$()

$(bold)Only these three kinds of magic are reduced$():$(li)$(bold)vanilla magic$() - potion damage, evoker fangs, warden sonic boom, thorns$(li)$(bold)Iron's Spells$() - all nine schools (fire / ice / lightning / holy / ender / blood / evocation / nature / eldritch)$(li)$(bold)Goety$() spells

$(bold)Everything else is untouched$(): physical (melee / arrows / explosions / fall), void, piercing and true damage, vanilla fire and lava, vanilla lightning, wither, poison, dragon breath, drowning, freezing, starvation - all at $(bold)full$() value.

$(italic)The check is shared with $(l:trait_magic_conduction)Magic Conduction$(), and two $(bold)vetoes$() run first:$(li)$(bold)physical$() - the $(bold)tinkersnewlife:is_physical$() tag and Goety's $(bold)goety:physical$() tag$(li)$(bold)void / piercing / rule-level$() - the $(bold)tinkersnewlife:ignores_mana_shield$() tag and vanilla $(bold)bypasses_invulnerability$()$(br2)Both tags live in the datapack and can be edited freely.$()
